dialogues.speaker: Yermolay
dialogues.text: ...My apologies. I'm on duty, stranger, and I cannot answer your questions. If you require assistance, you may seek out Avreliya.

dialogues.speaker: Yermolay
dialogues.text: Lady Shakhovskaya transferred me here precisely so that I might uphold the old rites of courtesy. Even in front of a fae lord, I would not commit the slightest breach of etiquette.
